Here’s a simple, fast weeknight dinner idea: **One‑Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken & Veggies**.  
- Ingredients (serves 2): 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes halved, 1 cup broccoli florets, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 cloves garlic minced, zest & juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt & pepper.  
- Method: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes, broccoli, chicken, oil, garlic, lemon zest/juice, oregano, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan. Spread in a single layer. Roast 25‑30 min, stirring halfway, until chicken reaches 165°F and veggies are tender. Serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon.
